title: Conformational Stability Guided Recognition of Human Telomeric G-quadruplex by Human BRCA1 Protein.
authors: Kabir, Sahil Hasan; Pendharkar, Rujuta A; Sadiq, Abdul R; Pal, Nibedita
journal: The journal of physical chemistry letters
one_liner_zh: 该文研究BRCA1蛋白对端粒G-四链体DNA不同构象的识别，结合分子建模与对接揭示构象选择性互作界面，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Human tumor suppressor protein BRCA1 recognizes noncanonical DNA structures orchestrating DNA damage repair and maintaining the genome integrity. Despite BRCA1's known preference for G-quadruplexes (G4) over double-stranded DNA, the molecular details underlying its recognition of distinct G4 conformations remain unclear. In this study, we investigated the direct interaction of human BRCA1 protein with two structurally distinct conformations of human telomeric G4 (hTeloG4) DNA - (3 + 1) hybrid and basket-type antiparallel hTeloG4. BRCA1 protein exhibited nearly 2-fold higher affinity for the hybrid hTeloG4 than the antiparallel conformation, indicating conformation-dependent recognition guided by G4 stability. Furthermore, under oxidative stress, which compromises G4 integrity due to guanine oxidation, BRCA1's binding affinity for both conformations reduced significantly. Molecular modeling and docking analyses highlighted distinct conformation-selective interaction interfaces between BRCA1 and hTeloG4. Together, these results provided insights into the conformation-guided recognition of hTeloG4 DNA by BRCA1 and suggested a potential mechanistic link between BRCA1-mediated telomere regulation.
abstract_zh: 人类肿瘤抑制蛋白BRCA1识别非经典DNA结构，协调DNA损伤修复并维持基因组完整性。尽管已知BRCA1对G-四链体（G4）的偏好性高于双链DNA，但其识别不同G4构象的分子细节仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们探讨了人类BRCA1蛋白与两种结构不同的人端粒G4（hTeloG4）DNA构象——(3 + 1)杂合型和篮型反平行hTeloG4——的直接相互作用。BRCA1蛋白对杂合型hTeloG4的亲和力约为反平行构象的2倍，表明其识别具有构象依赖性，且受G4稳定性引导。此外，在氧化应激条件下，由于鸟嘌呤氧化损害G4完整性，BRCA1对两种构象的结合亲和力均显著降低。分子建模和对接分析揭示了BRCA1与hTeloG4之间不同的构象选择性相互作用界面。综合这些结果，为BRCA1对hTeloG4 DNA的构象引导识别提供了见解，并提示了BRCA1介导的端粒调控的潜在机制联系。
